questions.explanation_hindi: so, a ≡ b (mod n) …(i) ⇒ n/a – b ⇒ a – b = tn (for some integer t) ⇒ a – b + c – c = tn ⇒ (a + c) – (b + c) = tn ⇒ n/[(a + c) – (b + c)] ⇒ a + c ≡ b + c (mod n). Next, from equation (i), a ≡ b (mod n) ⇒ n/a – b ⇒ a – b = sn : for some integer s. multiply by c on both side, ac – bc = (c. s) n ⇒ ac – bc = pn {c & s are integers}. ⇒ n/ac – bc ⇒ ac ≡ bc (mod n.)

questions.question_english: If n > 2 is an integer and φ(n), represents the Euler's totient function, then the value of φ(n) is:
questions.question_hindi: अगर ह ्न २ एक पूर्णांक है और φ(ह), यूलर्स टोशिएंट फंक्शन का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है तो φ(ह) का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation_english: We have to prove that. φ (n) is even for n > 2 Case (i) If n in power of 2 ⇒ n= 2k ⇒ φ (n) = 2k – 2k-1 clearly, φ (n) is even. Case (ii) If n is not power of 2 Then, n = product of primes. ⇒ φ (n) = p1 (p2 – 1) (p3 – 1) ∵ p → prime, p – 1 = even. Then. φ (n) must be an even no. Note: official Ans is (a).
